data.name: Ing
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse and Germanic roots, Ing means 'God' or 'Divine Power'. In Norse mythology, Ing was the name of a god associated with fertility, agriculture, and peace. In Christianity, this name can be seen as a reminder of God's presence and power in our lives.
